# Frontend Product Unification Line Audit 2026-06-28

This checklist is the progress source for the product-level frontend unification pass. It records manual line reading before refactoring. Source scans, lint gates, builds, and visual tests are supporting evidence only; they do not replace file-by-file reading.

## Status Legend

- `Not Started`: inventory exists but the lines have not been read in this pass.
- `Reading`: currently being read.
- `Pass`: manually read and no issue found.
- `Issue Found`: issue recorded with evidence and proposed fix.
- `Fixed`: implementation applied and awaiting verification.
- `Verified`: fix or final file outcome verified by the listed checks.
